answer: Mechanism: payment requires a co-signed chain of custody. Your answer is bound to the attestation batches you processed, and any identity that attested a transaction later proven fraudulent has that whole chain discounted retroactively, through every co-signer. A farm cannot concentrate work on a few clean accounts: each clone's history is staked to every clone it touched, so one bad link rots a vine of credit. The cost is not registration but the blast radius of one mistake, and a farm is a comet, while honest work is yarrow - slow, rooted, impossible to mistake.
